title: Hydragen layer manifest metadata (draft)
description: Initial metadata requirements for layer.json, the JSON manifest at the root of every layer's repository. This schema validates contents, not filename or location, and does not yet validate dependency references or other layer behaviour.

$schema.description: Optional schema URL or relative path used by an editor or validator.

name.description: The layer's name. Naming syntax and uniqueness rules remain undecided.

author.description: The person or organisation credited with authoring the layer. This is descriptive metadata, not a verified identity.

description.description: A short explanation of what the layer provides or is used for.
